sentences.text:
Vintners Association & Anr. vs . Union Of India & on 20 May,
2025

Author: Ajay Mohan Goel
Bench: Ajay Mohan Goel
.
Vintners Association & anr. Vs. Union of India & Ors.
Cwp No. 2281 of 2023.
20.05.2025
Present: M/s Goverdhan Lal Sharma and Satish Kumar, Advocates, for the petitioners.

Ms. Reeta Thakur, Cgsc, for respondents No.1 & Mr. Pushpinder Jaswal, Additional Advocate
General, for the respondents-State.

When the case was taken up for consideration, learned counsel for the petitioners informs the Court that a meeting was convened by Food Safety and Standards Authority of India with the stake holders on 07.05.2025 and certain discussions have taken therein.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: He accordingly submits that it would be in the interest of justice, in case, hearing of the petition is deferred by six weeks, so that outcome thereof can be informed to the Court.

(Ajay Mohan Goel) Judge May 20, 2025 (Shivank Thakur)
